evidence_rules.real_resource: 保留真实链接、来源、标题及视频身份/访问状态；标题是文章不能靠search_template当视频。付费/登录/地区限制不直接当无效链接，不能虚称播放核验。

rules: Different projects, datasets, constants, field/key/pin names and state labels may teach the same specific transferable skill. No full-project-video requirement and no automatic failure merely because project practice contains unknown constants.
A video may teach one skill or a grounded useful part; multiple sources may complement a unit. Keep partial scope and unknown depth explicit; never infer whole-unit/project completion from one facet.

A card count or lexical/API occurrence is not production acceptance. Each attributed skill needs the source strength stated: own specific title may establish topic relevance, own description/catalog a stated range, and own teaching excerpt a concrete method.

Reject fake or article-only video identity, wrong library substitution, borrowed related-list/negation/prerequisite/demo claims and false full/mastery labels. Login/pay/region restriction is an access state, not by itself a dead link.

Student fit follows actual background: advanced first-pandas/Matplotlib may need targeted library lessons; intermediate first-Streamlit reuses known pandas and learns actual date/multiselect controls; no broad course alone substitutes for pygame/state/debounce/deadline methods.

Separate software false claims/retrieval defects from honest external material gaps. A transparent gap can leave material utility partial without becoming a false claim, but does not by itself make a weak recommendation set useful enough to pass.

Do not prefill scores from static plan approval, matched coverage percentage, no-result counts or model verdicts. Wait for final r3 result binding, independent video_audit claims and manual skill/source review.
Keep the original rejected trials and first independent P2 findings. Manual edits/explicit new trials/search rebindings are separate; do not relabel a mixed-version final set as first-pass success.
